name: Opus Clip
tagline: Opus Clip uses AI to analyse long-form videos and automatically extract the most engaging segments, then reformats them into short-form clips for TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts. It adds captions, highlights keywords, and scores each clip for virality potential.
